instruction: In CCCH9003_Tutorial_guidelines.docx, change the font size of the first paragraph to 14pt.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1.5); pyautogui.press('return'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to separate sentences in the first paragraph by adding empty lines via Find & Replace (Ctrl+H). Used \n in replace field but LibreOffice didn't interpret it correctly. The document remained unchanged after 34 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open LibreOffice Writer, click in document, open Find & Replace dialog, type in fields, use keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+H, Ctrl+A, End)
metadata.failure_analysis: Agent failed because LibreOffice Find & Replace does not interpret \n as a newline character directly. The agent spent 34 turns trying to make it work.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to changing the font size of the first paragraph, targeting the demonstrated capability of selecting text and applying formatting. The original font is 12pt; changing to 14pt requires selecting the paragraph and using the font size control.
metadata.explanation: Task requires selecting all text in the first paragraph and changing the font size to 14pt. Evaluator downloads the .docx, reads the font size of the first run in Para 0 in EMU units (expected 177800 = 14 * 12700), then converts to points. Initial 12pt fails the check. [Fixed: replaced invalid 16-char MD5 suffix 'af8c55e1763430a3' with correct 32-char MD5 '7211ff5a62d6ff910c67632b31846d1c' in getter, metric, and evaluator config]
